ciFast.note: Fast verification will rerun the release ledger, complete suite, lint, and production build after push.

ciDeep.note: The current corpus is deliberately ineligible for the V5 whole-course adapter arm; no adapter-versus-base quality win is claimed.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of merge and remote verification.

liveProvider.note: Hosted Scion remains the pinned public Gemma 4 base plus the model-neutral compiler; no task-scoped quality adapter is active.

manualHuman.note: No human, instructor, classroom, or independent multi-judge validation is claimed.

manualBrowser.note: Deterministic runtime tests prove exact adapter use, base avoidance, adapter restoration, base canary restoration, and recovery-required failure.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The release changes adapter lineage, request routing, telemetry, and benchmark validity; it does not claim a model-output quality increase.

claims.summary: Every training row carries an explicit task family, and its row-complete allowlist is bound through dataset, training plan, adapter manifest, conversion, and runtime code lineage.
proofCommands: npx vitest run tests/scion-adapter-task-scope.test.js tests/scion-adapter-training-run.test.js tests/scion-adapter-manifest.test.js

claims.summary: Browser inference activates the adapter only for an exact trained family and proves exact base restoration for every other task before generation.
Every browser-local request can emit family, route, reason, adapter, manifest, scope, and native-state evidence into the generation trace.
proofCommands: npx vitest run tests/scion-local-provider.test.js tests/scion-stream-reader-local.test.jsx tests/scion-adapter-tooling.test.js

claims.summary: Held-out V5 preserves the exact five-course and transitive-grader ruler while requiring task-level adapter use, base avoidance, and zero unclassified calls.
The exact 143-row research rebuild contains 93 source-key-term and 50 source-MC atoms, zero lesson kernels, and is honestly ineligible for a whole-course adapter claim.
The next adapter experiment is constrained to stable source-grounded lesson-kernel preferences and must beat exact base-only Scion without increasing compiler burden.
No hosted adapter or Gemma weight changed; this release strengthens architecture and evaluation validity without claiming a new output-quality score.
